- Downloads from some servers (typically behind Cloudflare) now use multiple connections: those servers hide the range-support signal from the size probe while still accepting ranged requests, so every download used to fall back to a single connection pinned to one network adapter. The engine now tests an actual 2-byte ranged request when the headers are silent.
- As a result, NIC bonding (Settings: bond networks if set up in config) now actually shares these downloads between your uplinks, and file sizes show correctly in the task list instead of staying unknown.
- Existing paused single-connection tasks keep their old layout; remove and re-add the links to get the multi-connection download.
